c.tagline: Chile's neocolonial beach city and gateway to the star-filled Elqui Valley.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis (black with yellow roofs) are metered; colectivos are shared fixed-route taxis with a set fare shown on the windshield. Uber, Cabify and DiDi also operate.

emergency.note: 133 reaches Carabineros (police), 131 is SAMU ambulance, and 132 is firefighters.

avoid.reason: Avoid Las Compañías and the streets around the bus terminal late at night, where robberies are reported.
Watch belongings at La Recova market and on Avenida del Mar beaches; car break-ins occur at beach parking lots.

hood_desc: The neocolonial old town around the leafy Plaza de Armas, packed with restored churches, craft markets, museums and pedestrian streets - the best base for sightseeing and staying central.
The 3 km beachfront esplanade lined with aparthotels, cabañas, seafood restaurants and bars facing the Pacific; ideal for a relaxed beach stay in summer, though a short taxi ride from downtown.
The area around the iconic Faro Monumental lighthouse where Avenida del Mar meets the historic center, blending easy beach access with walkable proximity to town.
A quiet residential district between the center and the coast, with local markets, guesthouses and an authentic everyday feel at lower prices.
A beach and resort sector stretching toward neighboring Coquimbo, home to the Enjoy casino-resort, long sands and family cabañas; calm and car-friendly but away from La Serena's old town.
lodging: Enjoy Coquimbo Hotel de la Bahía

water.note: City tap water is safe to drink, though some prefer bottled for taste.

transit.pay: Pay the flat fare in cash to the driver on micros and colectivos - roughly CLP 500-800 (~$0.55-0.90) per ride. There is no rechargeable transit card; carry coins and small notes.
transit.hours: Micros and colectivos run roughly 6am to 10-11pm; taxis and ride apps cover later hours.
transit.note: La Serena has no metro; buses, colectivos and taxis cover the city, and it links to neighboring Coquimbo by frequent micros. The compact historic center is easily walked.

bus: Micros & colectivos to Coquimbo and the Elqui Valley

transit.m: Taxi or transfer to the center, ~10-20 min
Colectivo/micro from the main road to downtown, ~20-30 min

tip.r: ~10% at restaurants (often suggested on the bill as 'propina'); optional but expected for table service.
